dct_creator_sm: Limnology and Paleoenvironmental Research Group, York University.
dct_description_sm: A study funded by NWT CIMP (Project 251) was undertaken to assist Sambaa K’e First Nation in understanding current and future risk of potentially harmful cyanobacteria blooms in Sambaa K’e (Northwest Territories).  Regular sampling of water chemistry in Sambaa K’e and its connecting waters is being undertaken to gain a better understanding of nutrient sources and climate change impacts to the watershed.
dct_title_s: CIMP 251: Water quality data from Trout Lake and tributaries, Sambaa Ke, Northwest Territories, 2024-2026
